thread:
emily: Quick heads-up: we're scheduling a base-image rebuild + KMS rotation for next maintenance window. Major constraint: several HSM keys reject calls from userland binaries (cosign). Proposing a narrow "signing-proxy" pod that does KMS:Sign and returns signatures to CI. Need RBAC split, webhook guard, audit fields, and a concise rollback playbook. cc @raj @mia
raj: I like the signing-proxy idea. Requirements: 1) runs in isolated subnet, 2) nodeAffinity -> signing pool, 3) SA with only kms:Sign on specific key versions, 4) TTL token via tokenRequest (1h). Builders must not have any KMS perms.
mia: Audit/logging: proxy + cosign must emit structured JSON lines: `{"op":"sign","key_id":"...","signer":"svc-imagesigner@redwood","pod_uid":"...","image":"sha256:...","status":"ok|error"}`. Send to `splunk:index=images_audit` and to auditpipe. Make sure KMS logs include `callerIp` so we can correlate VPC.
emily: Also add RBAC guard: deny RoleBinding if subject is `builders/*` AND role contains `keys/*` verbs. OPA/webhook PR?
raj: I'll post an OPA policy later today. Quick sketch:
```
package rbacdeny
deny[reason] {
  input.binding.subject.namespace == "builders"
  some i
  input.binding.role.rules[i].contains("kms")
  reason = "builders must not be granted KMS rights"
}
```
mia: CI/QA: add step `signing-proxy-failover` that simulates KMS DENY and ensures helper fallback (manual signing pod) kicks in and pipeline fails if signatures can't be verified.
sec-bot: scan: found registry retention not set for base-images -> recommend protect last 25 signed tags and mark as immutable for 72h post-rotation
emily: Good catch. Also need SBOM diff gating: if delta introduces any CVE with severity >= 7.5, block rollout and create security-triage ticket.
raj: KMS rotation plan: create new key version, stage signing on staging cluster, run full cosign verify over canaries, then promote new key version. If promote fails, revert to previous key version and re-run verification. We'll keep old key version enabled for 72h as rollback window.
mia: Incident playbook (short): 1) Abort rotation & rebuild. 2) Pause deployments via release-war-room. 3) Re-enable previous key version & promote previous images. 4) Run cluster-wide `cosign verify` job. 5) If mismatches >0 -> page security oncall.
emily: Who's primary for the rotation night? I'll take primary, @raj backup. ops-oncall: you ok to own KMS IAM change during the window?
ops-oncall: Affirmative. Will need PR with IAM condition: `request.time < timestamp("2027-01-15T03:30:00Z") && source.vpc == "prod-signer-vpc"`. Will validate with kms-bot preflight.
raj: Added note: signing-proxy must annotate KMS requests with `x-proxy-pod` header (pod UID) so we can link KMS audit logs -> k8s. Also include signer identity in structured logs.
sec-bot: prereq-check: opa-webhook missing unit-tests -> mark blocking
emia: (typo) pinging @mia for tests :grimacing:
mia: on it — will add unit tests for webhook and ci integration for canary sig verification. ETA EOD today.
deploy-bot: ci: rebuild-base-6991234567 queued -> sbom-scan -> sign -> canary-verify
emily: One more: registry GC rule: do not prune tags with label `signed=true` until 7 days after rotation to avoid accidental rollback hole.
raj: I'll draft PR with RBAC, OPA webhook, signing-proxy manifest, and IAM condition. Tagging `security-review` and `devex` for logging config. Please review within 36h.
mia: Adding alert: `cosign.verify.fail_rate > 0.5% over 5m` -> page security-oncall.
emily: Thanks all — assemble checklist and calendar invite, will post the link to PRs here. :thumbsup:
